about: Readings a person checked where pypinyin's reading in context is not the right one (2026-10-24). The pin games show the books' reading; scripts/packs/tones/check.js accepts these and nothing else. chars: a reading right wherever the character is (no meaning hangs on it); phrases: a reading right in that phrase only; mismatch: a sim line whose hanzi and pinyin are not the same words (the tones follow the pinyin, which is what the game shows).

chars.谁 shei2: shéi: the reading every book prints (pypinyin reads the older shuí); same word, same meaning

长.长 chang2: the word «largo»: cháng (pypinyin reads zhǎng, «to grow»)

他的头发很长。.长 chang2: his hair is long: cháng (pypinyin reads zhǎng)

我的头发很长。.长 chang2: my hair is long: cháng (pypinyin reads zhǎng)

妈妈的头发很长。.长 chang2: Mom's hair is long: cháng (pypinyin reads zhǎng)

在这儿可以看见两只小猫。.只 zhi1: the measure word for animals: zhī (pypinyin reads zhǐ, «only»)

两只小狗.只 zhi1: the measure word for animals: zhī (pypinyin reads zhǐ, «only»)

mismatch.那不是我的猫，是我朋友的猫: old HSK sim 3: the hanzi ends «…我朋友的猫», its pinyin «…wǒ péngyou de» (no māo); the game shows the pinyin, toned as the golden book prints it
